One Page Website vs Shopify Store: Which Fits Your Business?

By Marie Glow StudioUpdated September 23, 2026

A one-page website does a lot of things well. It is fast to build, easy to understand, simple to keep up and far less expensive than a full store. For a service provider, a creator, a coach or a business that just needs a professional home base, one clear page can be exactly enough.

What it cannot do is run a shop. The Website Starter from Marie Glow Studio is a static one-page website, not Shopify and not e-commerce. The Complete Website and Brand Identity package is a full store. The question is not which one is better. It is which one matches what your business needs to do today.

These figures compare the Website Starter with the Complete Website and Brand Identity.

When a one page website is the better pick

The Website Starter is enough when:

  • You do not need to take orders on the site. If people contact you, book you elsewhere or buy through another platform, a single page can point them where to go.
  • You need to look credible quickly. A clean, mobile-friendly page with your story, offers and contact details beats having no site at all.
  • Your budget is small right now. At $249, it is a small starting investment to get online.
  • You sell through a marketplace. If your products live elsewhere, a one-page site can link out to them.
  • You are validating an idea. There is no reason to build a full store before you know what will sell.

Before you decide, read small business website essentials to check what a simple site should still cover. If you are also weighing hiring versus building it yourself, the same thinking applies to Pinterest in should I hire a Pinterest manager.

When you need a Shopify store

A store is the right call when customers need to browse and buy directly on your site, when you have a growing catalog to organize into collections, or when you want a complete brand identity built alongside the site. If you would need to add many pages and a cart on top of a one-page site, you are already describing a store. Our Shopify website checklist lists what a store should have in place.

Why some people choose Marie Glow Studio

Many owners are not tech savvy and do not want to spend their weeks fighting a website builder. They want more time building the business. What they get here is a clear scope with written inclusions, and a choice that does not lock them in too early.

  • Complete Website and Brand Identity: a custom primary logo, brand colors, font recommendations, visual brand direction, a style guide, social media graphics, full Shopify setup, a custom homepage, mobile-responsive layout, essential pages, navigation, product and collection organization for up to 20 items, a contact form, footer, policy pages, domain support and a full store review, testing and training.

How to decide

  1. Do visitors need to buy from my site, or can they contact me or buy elsewhere?
  2. Do I have, or plan to have, more than a handful of products?
  3. Do I already have a logo, colors and photos, or do I need a brand identity built too?
  4. Do I need the site live this week, or can I wait two to three weeks?
  5. Would I rather start small and upgrade later?

If the answers lean toward contact-only, limited products and speed, start with the Starter. If they lean toward selling, a growing catalog and a full brand, choose the store.

Closing guidance

Neither website will bring in customers by itself. Traffic comes from your marketing, and a site only converts the visitors it receives. Start with what you need this month, not the biggest thing you might need next year. When you are ready, see the web design options or start with the Website Starter.

Frequently asked questions

Is a one page website enough for my business?

A one-page website is enough when you do not need to sell products directly on the site. It works well for introducing your business, showing your offers and giving people a way to contact you.

Can the Website Starter sell products?

No. The Website Starter is a static one-page website, not Shopify and not e-commerce. If you need a cart and product pages, the Complete Website and Brand Identity package is the right fit.

How much does a Shopify store cost compared with a one page website?

The Marie Glow Studio Website Starter is $249 one-time and the Complete Website and Brand Identity package is $1,497 one-time. The Complete Website and Brand Identity includes full Shopify setup and a brand identity, and organizes up to 20 products and collections.

Can I upgrade from the Website Starter to a Shopify store later?

Yes. If you upgrade within 6 months, $100 of what you paid for the Website Starter is credited toward the Complete Package.

How long does each option take?

The Website Starter is delivered in 5 business days from a completed intake, or the revision round is free. The Complete Package takes roughly 2 to 3 weeks, depending on how quickly product images and content arrive.
